summary: Python released multiple expedited security updates (3.15.2, 3.14.10, 3.13.18, 3.12.16, 3.11.18) and earlier certified releases (3.15.1, 3.14.9, 3.13.17) to address compromised CA keys. UiPath expanded its AI capabilities with land‑deed processing and a new TypeSafe connector for Jev models, while Automation Anywhere detailed AI‑driven ticket resolution and a five‑phase agentic AI roadmap. Power Automate celebrated five years of its community conference, and Google announced new AI updates for October 2026, underscoring continued AI adoption across industries.
